About.label: About
About.paragraph1: At RDS Avocats, we bring together a team with complementary expertise in business, commercial and corporate law, as well as immigration, family, civil and criminal law. This diversity allows us to support our clients in every dimension of their reality, both personal and professional.
About.paragraph2: business immigration. We help entrepreneurs and foreign companies establish themselves in Canada while structuring their expansion and life projects here.
About.paragraph3: With RDS Avocats, you benefit from strategic, rigorous and human support — a solid legal partner to build, invest and succeed in Canada.
About.quote: Our approach: clear, strategic and growth-oriented.
About.subquote: We speak your language, we understand the entrepreneurial reality, and we help you move forward without slowing your momentum.

hanitra.title: Attorney
hanitra.description: As a business lawyer, I help entrepreneurs build, protect and grow their company without legal headaches. I turn complex contracts and legal obligations into simple, clear and strategic solutions. My role: helping you avoid unpleasant surprises and secure your decisions while you stay focused on growth. With me, the law becomes a concrete ally to move your projects forward with confidence.

fanta.title: Attorney
fanta.description: A passionate lawyer, Fanta practices family law, youth protection, criminal law as well as immigration and asylum claims. She welcomes each client with attentive listening, without judgment and with a genuine desire to understand their story. Whatever your background or how complex your situation may be, she is committed to clearly explaining your options and supporting you every step of the way. Serious in her advocacy, accessible in her approach — she is here for you.
